name: Water Damage Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Water Damage Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for water damage solutions.

overview: Water Damage Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach homeowners with active water damage from leaks, floods and appliance failures and connect them with mitigation companies ready to respond.

A homeowner with water pouring into a basement will call, not fill out a form. Inbound Call programs place local water damage response offers in front of homeowners searching in the moment of crisis and connect them directly to the mitigation company's emergency line. The caller expects immediate dispatch, and companies that answer around the clock and commit to a rapid arrival time convert these calls at very high rates. Inbound programs also allow companies to build direct customer relationships outside insurer-managed networks, capturing full-margin mitigation and reconstruction work.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of water damage consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners and property managers experiencing active or recent water intrusion, from single-room leaks to whole-floor flooding. The most valuable segments are insured homeowners with significant damage requiring extraction, drying and reconstruction, and multi-unit property owners where a single incident affects several units.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for water damage restoration or emergency water removal near me; burst pipe, water heater failure or appliance overflow in the home; sewer or drain backup affecting a basement or lower level; storm, heavy rain or flooding has entered the home.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "water damage restoration near me" and "emergency water removal", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard water damage criteria include: property located within the company's emergency response area; homeowner, property manager or authorised decision maker; source and approximate extent of water damage described; water intrusion is active or occurred recently, not a long-resolved event; homeowners insurance status and whether a claim is expected; requesting immediate or same-day service.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

faq.a: Yes, if your company offers around-the-clock response. Delivery can follow any schedule you set, and most mitigation companies choose continuous coverage because incidents happen at all hours.

faq.q: Do you screen for insurance coverage?
faq.a: Screening asks whether the homeowner has coverage and intends to file a claim, so you can prioritise insured losses and prepare documentation from the outset.

faq.q: Can you filter out minor incidents?
faq.a: The extent of the damage is captured during screening, and thresholds can be set so that small, self-manageable incidents are excluded before transfer.
